key_insight: GenDB-V enables AI agents to synthesize database engines specialized for hardware and workloads, with formal guarantees of SQL correctness and program safety.
engineering_relevance: It offers a path to faster database implementations without relying solely on costly manual optimization and testing for correctness.
method: Formalize SQL semantics with SQLSpec and construct fixed, implementation-independent synthesis targets.
Jointly synthesize fast code and modular proofs using storage–execution co-optimization and performance-first exploration.
Check generated code and proofs against the fixed targets in an isolated verification pipeline.
evidence_signal: On TPC-H and SEC-EDGAR, verified template implementations achieve 22.0–61.3× geometric-mean speedups over DuckDB and Umbra; a verified general-purpose engine achieves 1.27–3.4× speedups on TPC-H.
watch_item: Correctness guarantees are relative to SQLSpec and the supported SQL subset; the abstract does not establish coverage of full SQL or production-scale workloads.
paper_title: Stop Handcrafting Your Engine! GenDB-V: Towards AI-Generated and Formally Verified Database Systems
